Sobre o FAS O FAS Advogados é um escritório brasileiro full service, que atua em cooperação com o CMS – um dos maiores escritórios de advocacia do mundo. description:
Advogado(a) para atuar com Direito Privado

A AssempBH é uma entidade de classe, sem fins lucrativos. Atua na área de prestação de serviços para pessoas associadas oferecendo um leque de benefícios, a maioria deles extensivos a seus familiares, visando sobretudo contribuir para a melhoria da qualidade de vida. A missão é promover a união das pessoas servidoras do município por meio de benefícios nas áreas social, cultural, econômica e de saúde, além de representá-las na defesa de seus direitos e interesses em acordo com os termos do Estatuto da Associação.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) para atuar na área do Direito Privado , com foco no atendimento a associados e na condução de ações judiciais e extrajudiciais. O(a) profissional será responsável por prestar orientações jurídicas, elaborar peças processuais e representar os interesses dos associados em diversas instâncias.

Horário de trabalho: 9h às 18h de segunda a sexta-feira, com possibilidade de regime de trabalho híbrido.

Áreas de atuação do Direito Privado
  • Serviços Extrajudiciais: Elaboração de notificações extrajudiciais;
    Orientação e elaboraçãode reclamações e defesas junto a órgãos de defesa do consumidor, Banco Central, Ouvidorias, INSS, entre outros;
    Análise e revisão de contratos (pessoa física);
    Elaboração de termos deacordo;
    Orientação para doaçõese testamento;
    Divórcio, partilha e inventário extrajudiciais;
    Orientação para pedidosadministrativos de isenção de Imposto de Renda (IR) e valores retroativos.
  • Serviços Judiciais: Ações e defesas em Direito Civil, abrangendo relações de consumo, contratos, ações revisionais, indenizações, locação, cobranças e execuções, acidente de trânsito, usucapião e ações possessórias-petitórias;
    Ações de competência daVara da Infância e Juventude, incluindo adoção, vaga de menor na rede pública de educação, obtenção de passaporte, autorização de viagem, busca e apreensão de menor;
    Ações e defesas em Direito de Família, incluindo separação, divórcio, partilha, alteração de regime de bens, guarda, alimentos, paternidade, visitas, união estável e curatela;
    Ações de sucessões (inventário, alvará, registro, anulação e validação de testamento);
    Ações e defesas perantea Fazenda Pública Municipal, Estadual e Federal em questões sobre medicamentos, fertilização in vitro (FIV), descontos indevidos, restituições e indenizações, incluindo pedidos de isenção de Imposto de Renda (IR) e valores retroativos;
    Ações de competência daVara de Registros Públicos para retificação, inclusão e exclusão de nomes e sobrenomes;
    Atuação para defesa em execuções fiscais, exclusivamente, quando tiverem por fundamento bloqueio de verba impenhorável ou flagrante nulidade processual;
    Ações relativas ao FGTS, PIS/PASEP;
    Ações relativas a Concessionárias de serviço público de fornecimento de energia (CEMIG) e de água (COPASA) quanto a fraude e cobrança indevida.
Responsabilidades
  • Realizar atendimento jurídico aos associados, prestando orientações presenciais e remotos;
  • Elaborar peçasprocessuais, cumprir prazos/publicações;
  • Participar de audiências, sustentações orais e diligências;
  • Manter o controle e atualização dos processos em sistema interno;
  • Realizar pesquisas de doutrina, jurisprudência e legislação aplicáveis às áreas de atuação;
  • Elaborar relatórios e registros de atividades jurídicas do setor;
  • Acompanhar/revisar atividades de estagiários(as).
Requisitos
  • Graduação completa em Direito e inscrição ativa com quitação regular na OAB-MG;
  • Experiência comprovada nas áreas de Direito Privado;
  • Experiência emaudiências de conciliação e instrução;
  • Boa redação jurídica e domínio de técnicas processuais;
  • Organização, responsabilidade, potura ética e sigilo profissional;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão processual/plataformas judiciais, Pacote Office, Google Workspace e ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Comunicação clara e empática;
  • Capacidade de argumentação e negociação;
  • Atenção a detalhes, gestão de casos e prazos mais complexos;
  • Trabalho colaborativo e foco em resultados;
  • Conhecimento em LGPD;
  • Será um diferencial se você tiver especialização nas áreas de atuação.

✔ Transporte e Logística

A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
A Unico é a maior rede de verificação de identidade do mundo e um pilar de confiança na sociedade digital. Com soluções baseadas em biometria facial, machine learning e camadas reforçadas de segurança, autenticamos com 100% de certeza quem está realizando uma transação e os riscos de identidade atrelados. Desta forma, nossas soluções combatem fraudes, protegem dados e promovem a confiança entre pessoas, empresas e governos, colaborando para a construção de um mundo mais seguro e menos burocrático.

Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras;
impactamos sem rodeios;
somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis;
resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir;
fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

Missão : Buscamos uma pessoa Product Designer com alto nível de senioridade para atuar de forma estratégica e “mão na massa” no desenvolvimento de novas iniciativas da Unico. Essa pessoa terá um papel fundamental na construção de produtos com alto grau de inovação, colaborando com áreas estratégicas e contribuindo diretamente para elevar a régua de qualidade do time de Design .


O que você fará/será responsável por:
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções de design de ponta a ponta em produtos estratégicos da Unico, com foco em experiências simples, eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Atuar de forma transversal entre squads, contribuindo tanto com projetos em estágio de incubação quanto com produtos já consolidados (como IDPay e IDCloud).
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Product Managers, Engenharia, Dados e Stakeholders executivos para construir soluções que resolvam problemas reais de negócio.
  • Investigar a fundo as dores dos clientes, buscando brechas de inovação para posicionar os produtos da Unico como referência em UX e impacto.
  • Atuar como referência técnica em Design, promovendo qualidade, consistência visual e alinhamento com a visão de produto da empresa.
  • Navegar em ambientes complexos com autonomia, clareza e senso de dono, tomando decisões com base em impacto e viabilidade.
Experiências:
  • Sólida experiência (8 anos ou mais) em Design de Produto comprovada por cases ou portfólio que demonstrem seu processo e tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência em conduzir discovery, gerar hipóteses e, ao mesmo tempo, traduzir isso em soluções visuais, realizar testes e validações para garantir entregas de alto impacto.
  • Alta capacidade de negociar e se comunicar com equipes de negócios e engenharia, transformando problemas complexos em soluções viáveis e de boa experiência.
  • Vivência em ambientes B2B e B2C, com times multidisciplinares e estrutura de produto madura.
O que precisamos que você conheça:
  • Ferramentas de design (como Figma, Design Systems, ferramentas de prototipagem).
  • Product thinking: capacidade de pensar além da interface, influenciar roadmap e contribuir com decisões estratégicas de produto.
  • Pesquisa com usuários e interpretação de dados qualitativos e quantitativos.
  • Fluência em processos de discovery, ideação, prototipagem e entrega.
  • Habilidade para navegar em ambientes ambíguos com stakeholders exigentes.

Conheça os benefícios de se tornar um Ser Unico

Benefício flexível: R$ 1.500,00 por mês que podem ser distribuídos nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias;

Auxíliohome office: valor mensal de R$ 120,00 para pagamento de contas e consumo;

PLR : e legível a Participação nos Lucros e Resultados conforme acordo sindical;

Benefício Educação: a Unico financia 100% dos estudos para 100% dos colaboradores através de cursos disponíveis na plataforma Unico Skill. Você pode escolher entre graduação, pós-graduação, MBAs, idiomas, cursos especializantes e mentorias;

Bem-estar: acesso à plataformas como Gympass e Totalpass;

Licençaparental estendida: 180 dias para gestantes e cuidadores principais do processo de adoção e 60 dias para não gestantes e cuidados secundários do processo de adoção, com salário e benefícios pagos integralmente ao longo de todo o período.

Local de trabalho

Adotamos o modelo de trabalho que prioriza o remoto, o nosso #tetounico. Isso significa que os Seres têm a opção de frequentar os escritórios caso queiram, e de acordo com as necessidades de cada área. Temos escritórios nas cidades de São Paulo e Londrina.

E mais…

Oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado de acordo com suas competências e interesses, com oportunidade de crescimento como especialista ou líder, incentivando o seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional através de ciclos de avaliação de performance semestrais (com feedback estruturado e plano de desenvolvimento individual);

Paracompletar a sua experiência, por aqui temos palestras, meetups, workshops, treinamentos, day off no aniversário, reunioff às quartas-feiras, festas e celebrações internas/externas, happy hour presencial quinzenal, grupos de afinidade e ginástica laboral.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica.

Estamos construindo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e para nos apoiar em melhores práticas, criamos o formulário de Diversidade & Inclusão. Te convidamos a respondê-lo pra nos ajudar nesse processo, mas deixamos claro que você pode optar por não fazer isso sem impacto na sua avaliação. O compartilhamento desses dados não irá afetar o seu desempenho no processo seletivo e será usado somente para fins de criação de estratégias de inclusão.

Quer conhecer mais sobre a Unico?

Assista nosso manifesto;

Conheça nosso Medium de Tecnologia;

E nosso canal no Youtube com os Meetups de Tecnologia;

Acompanhe nossas redes sociais: LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook.

title: Gerente De Transformação De Finanças| Manager 2
description:
Aqui cada profissional é único!
As nossas pessoas atingem o seu máximo potencial através de treinamentos contínuos e exposição a oportunidades que os fazem sair da zona de conforto, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.
São estimulados a colaborar e contruir relações sólidas através de líderes inspiradores, trabalhando em equipes diversas com o objetivo de inovar, atingindo os melhores resultados. As conquistas são reconhecidas e celebradas, fomentando um ambiente inclusivo e desafiador.
Na PwC construímos confiança na sociedade resolvendo problemas importantes.
Conheça as possibilidades de carreira na PwC Brasil, alinhando o seu propósito ao nosso.

Job Description & Summary

Na PwC, nossos profissionais de consultoria financeira são especializados em fornecer serviços de consultoria relacionados à gestão e estratégia financeira. Esses profissionais analisam as necessidades dos clientes, desenvolvem soluções financeiras e oferecem orientação e suporte para ajudar os clientes a otimizar seu desempenho financeiro, aprimorar a tomada de decisões e atingir seus objetivos financeiros.
In enterprise performance management at PwC, you will focus on helping clients improve their financial performance and decision-making processes. You will analyse financial data, develop performance metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs), and design and implement performance management frameworks. You will be responsible for providing guidance on budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes to drive operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives.

Estamos em busca de um profissional sênior, com sólida experiência em Finanças e forte capacidade de liderança, para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de transformação financeira, com foco em soluções de Enterprise Performance Management (EPM). Este profissional será responsável por liderar equipes, conduzir projetos estratégicos e interagir diretamente com a alta gestão do cliente, garantindo a entrega de soluções inovadoras, alinhadas às melhores práticas do mercado e às necessidades do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a implementação de soluções EPM do início ao fim, coordenando equipes técnicas e de negócios para garantir entregas de alta qualidade.

  • Gerenciar relacionamentos com executivos e líderes estratégicos do cliente, compreendendo suas necessidades e apresentando recomendações técnicas e de valor agregado.

  • Conduzir workshops, reuniões de alinhamento e apresentações para stakeholders de diferentes níveis, incluindo C- level, demonstrando o impacto e benefícios das soluções propostas.

  • Definir estratégias de implementação que assegurem excelência na entrega, considerando arquitetura de dados, integração sistêmica e requisitos de negócio.

  • Orientar e desenvolver equipes de projeto, promovendo boas práticas, inovação e eficiência na execução.

  • Garantir a documentação adequada das soluções, alinhando requisitos funcionais às melhores práticas de mercado.

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências em gestão de desempenho empresarial e finanças, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções estratégicas para os clientes.

  • Apoiar o cliente na maximização do uso das soluções EPM, promovendo treinamentos avançados e suporte contínuo.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Finanças ou áreas relacionadas.

  • Experiência comprovada (geralmente 5+ anos) em consultoria de negócios, com foco em transformação de processos financeiros e implementação de soluções EPM (Oracle EPM, Anaplan, Onestream ou similares).

  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento com altos executivos, incluindo CFOs, diretores e outros líderes estratégicos.

  • Sólido conhecimento técnico em plataformas de EPM, arquitetura de integração, estrutura de dados e metodologias de implementação.

  • Conhecimento do processo de fechamento contábil e metodologia de custeio

  • Capacidade de liderar equipes multidisciplinares e gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

  • Inglês fluente (imprescindível para atuação em projetos internacionais).

  • Desejável conhecimento em programação (Python, SQL, R, etc. ) para suporte técnico e automação.

Competências comportamentais:

  • Liderança e influência para conduzir equipes e stakeholders de diferentes níveis.

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade de apresentar temas complexos de forma clara e convincente.

  • Proatividade, autonomia e forte orientação a resultados.

  • Capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e propor soluções inovadoras.

  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores.

title: Principal Ux Designer
description:
The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, we're looking for an exceptional Principal UX Designer to join our team as the strategic owner of our design system and design operations. This is a unique individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of visual design excellence, systems thinking, and technical implementation, ready to set the standard for design across our entire organization.

As the design system owner, you will be the cornerstone of design consistency and innovation across all our products. You'll work at the forefront of design-to-code initiatives, establishing processes that transform how our design and development teams collaborate. This role offers the rare opportunity to shape design culture, drive strategic decisions, and influence product experiences at scale, all while staying hands-on with the craft you love.

More specifically, you will:

  • Own and evolve our design system strategy, applying atomic design principles to create scalable, maintainable component libraries that serve as the foundation for all product experiences
  • Drive design system adoption and excellence by creating comprehensive documentation, establishing usage standards, and implementing quality assurance processes that ensure consistent, high-performing implementation across all teams
  • Lead the design-to-code transformation by partnering with development leadership to establish seamless workflows from Figma to production, positioning our organization at the forefront of modern design operations
  • Set design standards and accountability measures by auditing design work, identifying improvement opportunities, and working with UX directors to ensure teams maintain the highest standards of component usage and design consistency
  • Identify and integrate emerging design trends by staying current with industry patterns, evaluating new approaches, and strategically incorporating innovations that enhance our design system without disrupting established workflows
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment by communicating complex design decisions clearly, training teams on new patterns, and ensuring successful rollout of design system updates across the organization
What We Need From You
  • 8+ years of experience in UX/product design with significant focus on design systems, component libraries, and design operations within enterprise SaaS environments
  • Proven design system ownership with experience managing atomic design principles, maintaining component libraries, and successfully rolling out system updates across multiple teams
  • Strong technical foundation including understanding of CSS, component frameworks (like Bootstrap), React concepts, library versioning, and design-to-code workflows
  • An exceptional portfolio demonstrating design system work that shows both strategic thinking and meticulous execution, visual design excellence with keen attention to modern trends, clear documentation of complex design decisions, and examples of successful cross-functional collaboration
  • Experience as a systems thinker who understands atomic design principles deeply and has successfully managed design systems at scale
What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

  • Flexible Time-Off
  • Comprehensive Health benefits
  • Meal Vouchers to assist with food expenses
  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Mentoring Programs
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs
  • Virtual English Club through Rosetta Stone, and more!

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos\ ' cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries -- including half the Fortune 500 -- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

Opportunity

We are hiring a B2B Marketing Insights Director to our Marketing team in São Paulo, Brazil !

We are looking for a Director of B2B Marketing Insights Analysis to act as a strategic partner to the Marketing team, leveraging data to drive growth, influence demand generation, and maximize revenue. This role is the bridge between our data and business leaders, moving our team from reactive to proactive and data-driven approach. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, capable of understanding business challenges and analyzing data to tell a story that drives insights and action, translating complex analyses into compelling business narratives that optimize marketing performance and ROI.

Your Impact
  • Lead and manage the B2B marketing analytics/technical team, fostering their development and ensuring alignment with company objectives.
  • Lead the discovery of deep, localized insights from granular data to drive targeted initiatives and inform strategic decisions.
  • Act as a strategic partner in cross-functional forums with the Sales team, ensuring strong alignment between marketing initiatives and sales objectives to accelerate the pipeline.
  • Develop and deliver executive-level reports on demand generation and growth KPIs, providing actionable insights for senior leadership.
  • Define and unify B2B marketing funnel concepts (e.G., Traffic, Lead, MQL, Opportunities, Cost per Lead) to measure performance and its impact on revenue growth.
  • Oversee the development of dashboards and reports, applying data governance best practices to ensure data integrity.
  • Evaluate and implement marketing analytics tools and technologies (e.G., Tableau, Google Analytics, Salesforce) to support the B2B marketing funnel.
  • Leverage AI-driven insights and discussions for campaign optimization, multi-touch attribution modeling, or other B2B crucial initiatives to maximize marketing ROI.
  • Lead the B2B data budget and planning cycle, partnering with global business leaders to define targets and with the Data Strategy team on forecasting methodology.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.
Qualifications
  • Previous relevant years of progressive experience in marketing or overall analytics within a B2B SaaS environment, with experience in a leadership/management role.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation.
  • Solid grasp of the B2B lead-to-revenue funnel, including key metrics, lead scoring, and attribution models.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker), web analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude), and the MarTech ecosystem (Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Proven ability to influence strategy through data storytelling.
  • Strong leadership, proactivity, and the talent to translate complex data into compelling insights for diverse audiences.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.
  • Familiarity with AI use cases in B2B problems and AI/ML models.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. For this specific role, prior experience in marketing analytics within a B2B SaaS environment, managing and leading teams and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

What we offer you

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world. You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.
  • CAREER GROWTH : Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on social channels for life at Wellhub.

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Ele será responsável por orientar o time a construir estratégias que amplifiquem a divulgação de shows e turnês realizados pela companhia (antes, durante e depois da data do evento), além de pensar em maneiras de trabalhar a imagem pública da empresa em parceria com o time de PR institucional, garantindo uma comunicação consistente e positiva em plataformas variadas de mídia. O cargo em questão exige disciplina, um fluxo organizado e respeitoso com seus liderados e com outras áreas da 30e, com parceiros externos, além de uma sólida relação com a imprensa e com formadores de opinião.

O que você fará na 30e:
  • Gerenciar o time de PR, garantindo prazos e qualidade das entregas, fazendo divisão dos projetos internamente entre os times e garantindo uma equidade na relação entre os pares;
  • Supervisionar estratégias e execuções de PR, alinhando objetivos de negócios da companhia com os projetos e garantindo a implementação dos planos, respeitando os processos e alinhamentos com cada área interna na execução da estratégia de comunicação;
  • Gerenciar e organizar o contato do time com a mídia, comunicados à imprensa e anúncios corporativos para garantir uma comunicação consistente
  • Realizar reuniões de briefing, status e uma dinâmica diária eficiente com o time;
  • Monitorar e analisar a qualidade do trabalho de PR e de assessoria de imprensa, certificando-se que os contatos com terceiros, os releases e os planos apresentados estão no nível de uma empresa global, atento aos novos formatos de comunicação e na criatividade empregada em cada uma das ações do time;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com veículos de mídia locais, regionais e nacionais, jornalistas e influenciadores;
  • Criar ou estimular a criação de PR Stunts;
  • Acompanhar o trabalho do time no monitoramento da cobertura da mídia e produção de relatórios sobre a eficácia das ações de PR, sentimento da mídia e percepção da marca;
  • Fazer debrief dos projetos e relatórios, ressaltando as boas práticas e pontos de resolução;
  • Monitorar e acompanhar tendências do setor, atividades de concorrentes, notícias e informações para identificar oportunidades ou ameaças potenciais para PR;

title: Vp Global Marketing, Marktzugang & Preisgestaltung
description:
Targets of the position:

Drives the development and execution of integrated commercial strategies for our portfolio of biosimilar products. Leads a team of Directors and Managers that own and orchestrate global brand, marketing, pricing, market access, and reimbursement strategies to ensure successful launch and product uptake, long‑term value capture, and competitive differentiation in close collaboration with key markets, regions and other global functions.

Position in the Company:

Direct report to SVP Head of Global Marketing, Portfolio & Business Strategy.

Main Tasks: Commercial Strategy & Leadership
  • Set the global vision, strategy, future operating model as well as roles & responsibilities for Marketing, Market Access & Pricing in the dynamic biosimilar market environment.
  • Lead, inspire, and develop a high‑caliber team across marketing and market access functions.
  • Foster open collaboration and strong matrix way‑of‑working with Portfolio and Strategy team as well as Medical, Development/Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Governmental Affairs, Supply Chain and Regional/Local Commercial teams to ensure integrated commercial planning.
  • Serve as a key member of the Marketing, Portfolio & Business Strategy leadership team, contributing to portfolio prioritization and long‑term business strategy.
  • Support cross‑functional projects and represent the Marketing and Market Access function in relevant leadership meetings.
Brand and Global Marketing
  • Lead the development and implementation of global brand and above brand strategies across the biosimilar portfolio, aligned with clinical, regulatory, and commercial goals.
  • Define strategies for product positioning, messaging, early brand identity and naming/trademarking and value propositions (TPP) based on deep market insights, customer needs, and competitive dynamics.
  • Oversee launch and brand planning (from ~L‑24 months onwards), KPI tracking, supply allocation and execution for new products, ensuring excellence across multichannel marketing platforms.
  • Partner with regional and local commercial teams to adapt and execute strategies to local market needs.
  • Identify functional risk/opportunities across portfolio.
  • Institutionalize Marketing Excellence standards (segmentation, positioning, omnichannel planning, content operations, measurement, tender and pricing excellence) and Digital Marketing best practices to raise capability globally.
  • Support Market Insights team to establish strategy for generation of deep customer, market, and competitor insights.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for portfolio optimization, messaging, and access strategy.
Market Access & Pricing
  • Shape the future strategy for Market Access, Pricing and HEOR approach in alignment with major functions.
  • Implement the global Market Access & Pricing strategy and set guardrails for list/net price, discounting, tendering, and price corridor management in close collaboration with Regions/Local Marketing Units.
  • Define blueprint for payer value propositions, economic models, and value messages including a competitive KAM approach across relevant markets.
  • Design and drive global, regional and local pricing strategies to support optimal access and sustainable value capture.
  • Oversee payer/HTA research and insight generation and develop strategies to support timely and favorable reimbursement outcomes.
  • Coordinate with Government Affairs & Policy and Regulatory to anticipate access and policy shifts and adapt commercial and pricing strategies ensuring competitiveness.
  • Support the development of tools and platforms like tender and pricing databases to support successful access strategies.
Other Tasks:
  • Contribute to portfolio strategy and scenario planning.
  • Drive cross‑functional alignment on future blueprint for development on endpoints, evidence plans, TPP that maximize market potential.
  • Represent the function externally with payers, HTA bodies, KOLs, and strategic partners.
  • Support BD/licensing assessments from a brand, access, and pricing perspective.
  • Ensure compliance with all promotional and pricing regulations and internal policies.
  • Owns planning and tracking of budget for Marketing, Market Access/Pricing/HEOR and Marketing Excellence.
  • Deputize for SVP Global Marketing, Portfolio & Business Strategy and represent team in relevant management meetings.
Qualification and Experience:
  • EDUCATION: Degree level education preferably in science or equivalent experience. Post‑graduate degree strongly preferred (MA, MS, MBA, PhD).
  • JOB SPECIFIC COMPETENCIES & SKILLS:
    • Ability to create and nurture diverse, agile and adaptable teams capable of responding to fast‑changing market dynamics, policy shifts, and crises.
    • Strong results‑driven business acumen, strategic thinking and ability to simplify complexity.
    • Customer‑centric mindset able to translate market insights into actions.
    • Excellent communication, collaboration, and influencing capabilities across hierarchies.
    • Cultural agility and ability to operate effectively in a fast‑growing global matrix environment.
    • Ability to attract and develop top talent.
  • LANGUAGES: English mandatory, other languages an asset.
  • WORK EXPERIENCE:
    • Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in biopharma with at least 4 years in biosimilar as well country‑level commercial leadership roles (e.G., General Manager, Business Unit Head, Country Market Access Lead) preferably in the US.
    • Demonstrated success in launching and managing biosimilars or specialty biologics, including in complex pricing and reimbursement environments.
    • Deep understanding of global market access dynamics, payer decision‑making, and evolving biosimilar policy frameworks ideally backed by direct experience in the US market.
    • Strong leadership skills with experience in building and mentoring diverse teams across geographies and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
Requirements / Knowledge to fulfil the position:
  • Expertise in the biosimilar space (focus US and EU, other regions a plus) and specifically launch preparation and execution.
  • Understanding of current US market environment and key success factors a major plus.
  • Expertise in global and local marketing, sales and market access and cost forecasting, and P&L reporting.
  • Experience in leading a team of senior experts and cross‑functional project teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to deal with complexity and translate insights and conceptual ideas into strategies.
  • Robust understanding of product development and ability to influence early product development and strategy.

title: Head Of Creative Marketing
description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Head of Creative Marketing to join Wildlife's Marketing Team in São Paulo and lead our efforts in Creative Marketing, Influencers and IP Licensing.

As part of the Marketing Leadership, you will play a pivotal role in scaling our ever-growing portfolio of games. By leveraging your analytical skills, creativity, and in-depth market knowledge, you will be in charge of experimenting with new AI technologies and acquisition channels that will shape the future of our Marketing operation.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a “take the initiative” environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you'll do
  • Creative Marketing: You lead our in-house agency, in charge of the ideation and production of the ads running in our marketing campaigns. You will also manage external agencies that complement our internal production.
  • Influencers: You will lead and scale our influencer marketing efforts, tailored to the target audiences, leveraging their reach and engagement with a result-oriented mindset to deliver our business goals.
  • IP Licensing: Cultivate and maintain relationships with partners from different natures (Sports Federations, global studios among others), negotiating contracts, making internal ROI projections and delivering best-in-class go to markets, together with the product teams.
  • Campaign Analytics: Utilize data analytics tools to track and analyze the performance of campaigns, measuring key metrics such as investment, and media / business metrics.
  • Trend Monitoring: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitor strategies, and emerging platforms or features within performance marketing, social media and influencer marketing landscapes, adapting strategies accordingly to maintain competitiveness and innovation.
What you'll need
  • Strong team management skills as you will lead a 30+ organizational structure.
  • Deep understanding of the mobile marketing landscape, how different players operate and what are the main challenges and opportunities.
  • Autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result as well as promoting changes in the organization depending on the current situation.
  • Outstanding analytical skills to understand performance and make data-driven decisions.
  • Familiarity and affinity with the gaming industry.
  • Creative mindset with the ability to think outside the box.
  • Strong commitment.
  • A strong bias toward action.
  • A strong learning mindset always seeking opportunities to improve.
  • Advanced English proficiency is mandatory.
About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Creative Director- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Creative Director- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Join to apply for the Creative Director- Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package role at aramco

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Senior Creative Director to join our Creative Design Unit with the Corporate Communications Administrative Area.

Creative Design Unit is a fast-paced, in-house creative organization that operates like a full-service advertising and design agency. Our work spans marketing campaigns, strategic storytelling, visual identity systems, design experiences across every touchpoint.

Your primary role is to set the tone and direction for the team, bringing clarity, energy, and inspiration to every brief.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on big ideas, with a visionary creative directions skill to lead and elevate our creative team, loves design at its highest standard, and has a proven ability to translate business objectives into powerful, meaningful creative work.

Key Responsibilities

As Creative Director, you will be responsible for the following:

  • Shaping the creative vision of the unit and ensuring it is consistently executed across all projects.
  • You will guide multidisciplinary teams through the development of concepts and campaigns, ensuring alignment with the organization’s strategic goals.
  • From brand development and design systems to large-scale integrated campaigns, your leadership will be central in delivering work that is engaging, cohesive, and impactful.
  • You will work closely with senior stakeholders to understand objectives, define creative strategies, and present ideas with clarity and conviction.
  • You will oversee the full creative process—from concept to execution—ensuring work meets the highest standards of quality and innovation.
  • A key part of your role will also involve mentoring creative talent, building a strong team culture, and fostering a space where original thinking thrives.
  • A minimum of 10 years of creative experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role within a creative agency or in-house creative team.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating creative direction across branding, advertising, and digital campaigns is essential.
  • You should have deep knowledge of visual communication, typography, brand systems, storytelling, and design strategy, with hands-on experience in leading multi-channel creative work.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and presentation skills are required, along with a proven ability to manage and mentor a diverse creative team.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard design tools is expected, and familiarity with motion, video, or experiential media is a strong advantage.
  • A degree in design, visual communication, or a related field is preferred

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Head Of External Relations
description:
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

OKX is seeking a strategic and execution-driven professional to lead its external relations strategy in Brazil. This role is designed to focus on engagement with legislators, executive branch officials, trade associations, industry leaders, and other key stakeholders — playing a central role in shaping how digital assets are understood and integrated into Brazil’s economic landscape.

As Head of External Relations , you will report directly to the CEO of OKX Brazil and act as a key voice for the company’s local strategy and institutional reputation. While the role will support regulatory engagement when aligned with broader market initiatives, the core mission is to represent OKX in Brasília, São Paulo, and across Brazil’s institutional ecosystem — bringing clarity, data, and constructive dialogue to advance the role of crypto in the country’s economy.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of Brazil’s institutional and economic landscape with a passion for innovation and financial transformation. You’ve successfully engaged with decision-makers in Congress, executive agencies, trade bodies, and organizations such as the Free Market Institute. You are proactive, persuasive, and comfortable operating in institutional, economic, and media-facing environments.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Lead OKX Brazil’s government engagement strategy, building trusted relationships with legislators, senior government officials, and political institutions.
  • Represent OKX in political and public policy discussions, including in congressional hearings, forums, industry roundtables, and institutional meetings.
  • Monitor and interpret legislative developments, flagging risks and opportunities while aligning with internal teams on positioning and responses.
  • Help craft OKX Brazil’s public narrative through thought leadership, speaking engagements, and written contributions that support the company’s strategic priorities.
  • Partner with legal and compliance teams to ensure that regulatory interactions are consistent with broader government engagement goals.
  • Build alignments with other market participants and advocacy organizations to advance shared interests and protect the integrity of the local crypto market.
  • Serve as a key spokesperson for OKX in Brazil’s policy ecosystem, echoing the company's mission to be a responsible, constructive, and long-term player in the local economy.
What We Look For in You
  • Residents of São Paulo with strong experience navigating the local political and legislative environment.
  • 10+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, or political advisory roles — ideally within financial services, technology, or a highly regulated sector.
  • Proven track record of engagement with legislators, ministries, and policy-focused organizations.
  • Strong communication and advocacy skills — able to influence, inform, and build credibility with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a global, fast-paced, and high-growth environment.
  • Strategic thinker with sound judgment, political awareness, and strong execution capabilities.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written).

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX\ 's Candidate Privacy Notice.

We also offer benefits and programs such as L&D and Education subsidies, team-building events, wellness and meal allowances, and comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependents.

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Please note: This role requires fluency in both Portuguese and English to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders. It also requires a hybrid work model with regular in-office presence.

title: Head Of Brand - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Brand in Brazil, you’ll build on Luzia’s existing brand foundation and bring it to life locally, adding the cultural nuance and emotional depth that resonates with Brazilian users. You’ll craft a distinctive, human brand presence that feels both consistent with our global identity and uniquely relevant to the local market. You’ll lead the charge in shaping how millions of people experience and connect with Luzia, working cross-functionally to build a brand that drives love, loyalty, and organic growth — positioning Luzia as the most trusted and beloved AI assistant in one of our most important markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and define Luzia’s brand in Brazil— identity, and voice to reflect the cultural context, emotional tone, and everyday realities of our Brazilian audience.

  • Create emotional connections with users— craft narratives, campaigns, and experiences that go beyond utility and build lasting emotional bonds with millions of users.

  • Champion brand consistency— ensure a unified voice and visual identity across all touchpoints: product, marketing, tech, and talent.

  • Manage Public Relations and storytelling efforts— partner with Brazilian agencies and internal teams to build earned local media strategies and tell stories that resonate with both mainstream and underserved communities.

  • Collaborate across teams— work hand-in-hand with product, growth, comms, and design to bring brand ideas to life and make sure everyone internally is aligned around a clear brand mission.

  • Translate insight into impact —lead research efforts on market positioning, user sentiment, and competitive dynamics in Brazil, acting as the closest voice to our users and ensuring their needs, culture, and perspective shape brand decisions at every level.

  • Use content and influencers as strategic tools— partner with local creators, ambassadors, and users to grow organic reach and relevance.

  • Drive organic brand growth — focus on strategies that scale awareness and engagement through word-of-mouth, content, SEO, and product-led storytelling — not just paid media.

  • Manage budgets and agency partners— oversee brand-related investments, including agency collaborations ensuring high return and aligned execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strategic brand builder who’s done this before in Brazil— ideally in a high-growth consumer tech company or strong brand-led startup.

  • Deep experience in brand, mobile, and PR— you know what it takes to launch and scale brand presence in the Brazilian market.

  • A strategic operator— able to zoom out and set long-term direction, while also rolling up your sleeves to execute or manage projects day-to-day.

  • Stay deeply connected to our audience— read comments and reviews, engage directly with users, and immerse in the behaviors, trends, and desires of Brazilian young adults to continuously adapt our messaging and brand voice.

  • Obsessed with the user— you’re constantly engaging with users and deeply in tune with Gen Z and Millennials, our core audience. You draw insight from their behaviors, language, and culture to craft brand experiences and messaging that genuinely resonate.

  • A storyteller at heart— with a gift for creating narratives that spark curiosity, trust, and emotion.

  • Fluent in visual and emotional branding— with strong creative sensibility and the ability to direct top-tier brand work.

  • Collaborative to the core— able to inspire teams, work across functions, and align stakeholders behind the brand vision.

  • Analytically sharp and resource-savvy— focused on high-impact, measurable initiatives and able to prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Tuned-in to Gen Z & Millennials— you intuitively speak their language, tap their cultural cues, and craft experiences that land with Brazil’s digital-native generations.

  • AI-savvy experimenter— eager to explore, question, and ship breakthrough AI features that put cutting-edge tech directly in users’ hands.

  • Fluency in English is required;
    Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a tech startup or fast-scaling mobile app in Brazil.

  • Track record of working closely with product and growth teams to align brand and user experience.

  • Ability to balance instinct and data — you know when to trust the numbers and when to lead with bold intuition.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you\ 're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

1. Gestão Operacional e Comercial

- Supervisionar as equipes de atendimento, vendas e suporte técnico, assegurando desempenho alinhado às metas da agência.

- Garantir a execução eficiente e padronizada dos processos operacionais, como reservas, emissões, cancelamentos e reembolsos.

title: Head Of Brand - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Brand in Brazil, you’ll build on Luzia’s existing brand foundation and bring it to life locally, adding the cultural nuance and emotional depth that resonates with Brazilian users. You’ll craft a distinctive, human brand presence that feels both consistent with our global identity and uniquely relevant to the local market. You’ll lead the charge in shaping how millions of people experience and connect with Luzia, working cross-functionally to build a brand that drives love, loyalty, and organic growth — positioning Luzia as the most trusted and beloved AI assistant in one of our most important markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and define Luzia’s brand in Brazil— identity, and voice to reflect the cultural context, emotional tone, and everyday realities of our Brazilian audience.

  • Create emotional connections with users— craft narratives, campaigns, and experiences that go beyond utility and build lasting emotional bonds with millions of users.

  • Champion brand consistency— ensure a unified voice and visual identity across all touchpoints: product, marketing, tech, and talent.

  • Manage Public Relations and storytelling efforts— partner with Brazilian agencies and internal teams to build earned local media strategies and tell stories that resonate with both mainstream and underserved communities.

  • Collaborate across teams— work hand-in-hand with product, growth, comms, and design to bring brand ideas to life and make sure everyone internally is aligned around a clear brand mission.

  • Translate insight into impact —lead research efforts on market positioning, user sentiment, and competitive dynamics in Brazil, acting as the closest voice to our users and ensuring their needs, culture, and perspective shape brand decisions at every level.

  • Use content and influencers as strategic tools— partner with local creators, ambassadors, and users to grow organic reach and relevance.

  • Drive organic brand growth — focus on strategies that scale awareness and engagement through word-of-mouth, content, SEO, and product-led storytelling — not just paid media.

  • Manage budgets and agency partners— oversee brand-related investments, including agency collaborations ensuring high return and aligned execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strategic brand builderwho’s done this before in Brazil— ideally in a high-growth consumer tech company or strong brand-led startup.

  • Deep experience in brand, mobile, and PR— you know what it takes to launch and scale brand presence in the Brazilian market.

  • A strategic operator— able to zoom out and set long-term direction, while also rolling up your sleeves to execute or manage projects day-to-day.

  • Stay deeply connected to our audience— read comments and reviews, engage directly with users, and immerse in the behaviors, trends, and desires of Brazilian young adults to continuously adapt our messaging and brand voice.

  • Obsessed with the user— you’re constantly engaging with users and deeply in tune with Gen Z and Millennials, our core audience. You draw insight from their behaviors, language, and culture to craft brand experiences and messaging that genuinely resonate.

  • A storyteller at heart— with a gift for creating narratives that spark curiosity, trust, and emotion.

  • Fluent in visual and emotional branding— with strong creative sensibility and the ability to direct top-tier brand work.

  • Collaborative to the core— able to inspire teams, work across functions, and align stakeholders behind the brand vision.

  • Analytically sharp and resource-savvy— focused on high-impact, measurable initiatives and able to prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Tuned-in to Gen Z & Millennials— you intuitively speak their language, tap their cultural cues, and craft experiences that land with Brazil’s digital-native generations.

  • AI-savvy experimenter— eager to explore, question, and ship breakthrough AI features that put cutting-edge tech directly in users’ hands.

  • Fluency in English is required;
    Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a tech startup or fast-scaling mobile app in Brazil.

  • Track record of working closely with product and growth teams to align brand and user experience.

  • Ability to balance instinct and data — you know when to trust the numbers and when to lead with bold intuition.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you're passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

title: Head De Marketing
description:
Resumo

Liderar a estratégia de marketing da empresa, definindo diretrizes e conduzindo ações integradas de branding, comunicação e crescimento, para fortalecer a imagem institucional, atrair clientes e impulsionar os resultados de negócios.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Definir e liderar a estratégia de marketing da organização, analisando tendências de mercado, comportamento do consumidor e posicionamento da concorrência, para garantir diferenciação competitiva e alinhamento ao planejamento estratégico.
  • Desenvolver o plano anual de marketing, estabelecendo objetivos, metas e KPIs, para direcionar recursos e mensurar resultados com precisão.
  • Gerir o branding da empresa, coordenando identidade visual, tom de voz e posicionamento institucional, para fortalecer a marca em todos os pontos de contato.
  • Planejar e executar campanhas integradas de marketing, alinhando ações digitais, offline e eventos, para ampliar alcance e reforçar engajamento com o público-alvo.
  • Supervisionar a produção de conteúdos estratégicos, validando relevância e aderência à estratégia, para atrair, educar e converter clientes potenciais.
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e satisfação de clientes, aplicando metodologias quantitativas e qualitativas, para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novos nichos de atuação.
  • Gerir o orçamento de marketing, alocando recursos com foco em ROI, para otimizar investimentos e garantir eficiência.
  • Acompanhar performance de canais digitais, utilizando ferramentas de análise de dados e métricas de conversão, para embasar decisões de campanhas e estratégias.
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com agências e parceiros estratégicos, negociando contratos e validando entregas, para assegurar qualidade e alinhamento às necessidades da empresa.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de marketing digital avançado, incluindo SEO, mídia paga, inbound e automação, para potencializar aquisição e retenção de clientes.
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de marketing, distribuindo responsabilidades, acompanhando performance e promovendo treinamentos, para garantir engajamento, motivação e alta performance.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas comerciais e de produto, alinhando campanhas e propostas de valor, para maximizar resultados de vendas e lançamentos.
  • Gerenciar crises de imagem e reputação da empresa, definindo planos de comunicação rápida e transparente, para preservar credibilidade e confiança no mercado.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, palestras e mídias, fortalecendo networking, para ampliar visibilidade institucional e autoridade no setor.
  • Promover cultura de inovação dentro da área de marketing, testando novas ferramentas e metodologias ágeis, para manter competitividade e acompanhar mudanças do mercado.
Competências técnicas
  • Formação necessária: Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Marketing, Gestão Estratégica ou Digital Business altamente desejável.
  • Tempo mínimo de experiência: 8 a 10 anos em marketing, com pelo menos 3 em posições de liderança.
  • Impreterivelmente ter conhecimento do Mercedo Editorial e de Varejo Editorial
  • Atuar com independência estratégica, tomando decisões críticas sobre recursos, investimentos e direcionamentos da marca.
Conhecimentos técnicos essenciais
  • Marketing estratégico e digital.
  • Planejamento de campanhas omnichannel.
  • Branding e posicionamento de marca.
  • Gestão de budget e ROI.
  • Ferramentas de análise de dados (Google Analytics, Power BI, CRM, etc.).
  • SEO, SEM, inbound marketing e automação.
  • Gestão de equipes e metodologias ágeis aplicadas a marketing.

title: Creative Director | Talent Pool
description:
We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are looking for a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team player, who likes to share knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those who aren't afraid to experiment and fail, and are ready to create something new.

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Creative Directors are responsible for defining and nurturing the product’s vision, understanding the company’s strategic goals, and keeping everyone’s efforts focused towards the same direction.

Always aligned with the Production Manager and the Head of Studio, Creative Directors are responsible for defining and constantly reviewing the scope to keep projects on budget and on time.

This work also requires establishing the foundations of the experiences in all three pillars (artistic, systems, and narrative). The Creative Directors will articulate their vision, fostering an environment of collective creativity that inspires the team to come up with the best ideas, choosing the ones that fit into a coherent whole.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:
  1. Define a clear and reasonable creative vision for the product.
  2. Work closely with the Core Team members to develop their specific parts of the vision, tying together all artistic and technical elements.
  3. Constantly review the priorities and scope of each product delivery and/or milestone together with the Product Manager, considering the Value Proposition and goals of the product, but at the same time championing the product’s unique vision.
  4. Review production timelines, budget, and team performance with the Product Manager.
  5. Nurture and communicate the overall creative direction on an ongoing basis, inspiring the team through leadership.
  6. Be aware of internal and external QA results to direct creative decisions, ensuring the product meets main stakeholders' needs.
  7. Guarantee the consistency and quality of the product, ensuring creative cohesion between the user experience and company strategy.
  8. Serve as the spokesperson for the product’s vision within the team, for the press, and corporate management.
MUST HAVE:
  • Experience in a creative leadership position on at least one high-quality professional entertainment product/property shipped or delivered in industries such as XR, Games, Movies, Television, Advertisement, or Comics.
  • Positive leadership qualities.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to listen and communicate effectively (spoken and written).
  • Fluency in English.
  • Understanding and sensitivity to capturing the spirit of the moment (Zeitgeist).
  • Deep understanding of current trends in XR, gaming, and entertainment industries, influencing user expectations and behaviors.
  • Huge curiosity and openness to research and expand knowledge in virtual reality games, narratives, immersive art, etc.
NICE TO HAVE:

description:
Somos a Sólides , a única empresa de tecnologia brasileira de Gestão Integrada de Pessoas com Inteligência Comportamental . Nossa plataforma é #completadeverdade , com soluções para RH e Departamento Pessoal, feitas para todos os negócios do país.

Em 2022, nossa história ganhou ainda mais força! Recebemos o maior investimento já feito em uma HR Tech na América Latina — R$ 530 milhões, liderado pelo fundo Warburg Pincus — e adquirimos o Tangerino. Em 2024, a compra da Folha de Pagamento Digital nos consolidou como a one stop shop das PMEs e a união com RHGestor reforçou nosso compromisso de tornar a gestão de pessoas estratégica acessível a todas as empresas. Hoje, com mais de 40 mil clientes e 15 milhões de vidas impactadas , lideramos o setor de empresas de alto crescimento no Brasil.

Para chegarmos onde ninguém mais chegou, nossos valores são o nosso guia: somos corajosos para ser diferentes, fortes para alcançar resultados extraordinários, especialistas em pessoas e apaixonados pelos nossos clientes . Se você também é movido por sonhos, resultados e pessoas, vem que a Sólides é seu lugar!

Buscamos um Coordenador(a) de Marketing de Produto para nos ajudar nesta missão para liderar a estratégia de posicionamento de nossos produtos no mercado. O profissional será a voz do cliente dentro da empresa e a voz da empresa no mercado, garantindo que nossos produtos atendam às necessidades do público e sejam comunicados de forma eficaz. Você será responsável por transformar os recursos técnicos dos produtos em propostas de valor claras e convincentes para os nossos clientes.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolver e executar planos de marketing de produto, incluindo estratégias de posicionamento, mensagens e "go-to-market" para novos produtos e atualizações.
  • Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e análise da concorrência para identificar oportunidades e diferenciais competitivos.
  • Definir as personas dos clientes e suas jornadas, garantindo que todas as ações de marketing sejam direcionadas para o público certo.
  • Gerenciar materiais de marketing de produto, como apresentações de vendas, estudos de caso, white papers, landing pages e conteúdo para blog e redes sociais.
  • Coordenar o planejamento e a execução de lançamentos de produtos com equipes multifuncionais (Desenvolvimento, Vendas, Suporte ao Cliente, etc.).
  • Garantir que a equipe de vendas e outras equipes voltadas para o cliente estejam treinadas e equipadas com as informações e os materiais necessários para vender e promover os produtos com sucesso.
  • Analisar o desempenho dos produtos e das campanhas de marketing, utilizando métricas-chave (taxa de conversão, ROI, engajamento, etc.).
  • Coletar e interpretar feedback de clientes para gerar insights que ajudem a melhorar o produto e as estratégias de marketing.
  • Produzir relatórios executivos e estratégicos sobre o desempenho dos produtos dentro da organização.

Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Formação superior em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em marketing de produto.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e do ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de diferentes áreas.

title: Principal Game Designer, Engagement
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGNWhat We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You’ll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Principal Game Designer to tackle high-level engagement challenges across the Fortnite ecosystem. This includes innovating existing systems like Quests and Passes and creating entirely new structures to guide the player experience across the growing platform. Designers at Epic drive vision across cross-disciplinary development teams to engage players with goals that enrich their knowledge and tie in to broader forms of progression.

In this role, you will
  • Craft meaningful goals for players that build their exposure, experience, and mastery of new and existing game mechanics, all while immersing them in the world of Fortnite
  • Spearhead innovation in design for the engagement space, including systems, progression, and rewards, fulfilling key engagement metrics and supporting broad systematic framework needs
  • Communicate and represent a vision for the player’s experience to multiple teams across the company, as well as supporting teams of all crafts to optimize their engagement
  • Collaborate with product management and marketing teams to ensure player satisfaction and overall game health while driving growth across the ecosystem and supporting key activations
  • Drive collaborative and iterative live design to prototype quickly, make changes live soon after, learn from them, and iterate
What we’re looking for
  • 10+ years of experience shipping multiple titles as a game designer, working on engagement content or goal-based progression systems in live-service multiplayer environments
  • Demonstrated talent for empathizing with players and a deep understanding of player motivations, forms of play, and the effects of goal setting on play
  • Strong interest in BR and the Fortnite Ecosystem with an understanding of what makes them work
  • Able to react quickly to changing project needs and drive decisions, then own that vision
  • You’re player-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.E., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here.
